设计意图： This Price-Volatility Behavior signal measures tail fragility rather than ordinary return volatility. A stock in a sustained drawdown whose recent intraday excursions are disproportionately below the prior close has asymmetric downside volatility and weaker shock absorption; the negative sign favors assets with less such fragility. Squared tails emphasize economically consequential downside excurs

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ 已翻转（IC<0）⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

-(20-day downside tail-energy share) × (60-day close drawdown), where tail energy is squared excursion from prior close to low or high.
依赖列: high, low, close

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply((-divide(⊗1, add(⊗1, ts_sum(power(divide(clip(subtract(AdjHigh, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), , 1), ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 2), 20)))), subtract(1, divide(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjClose, 60))))
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(⊗1, add(⊗1, ts_sum(power(divide(clip(subtract(AdjHigh, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), , 1), ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 2), 20)))
  3. 3. add —— 加法
    add(⊗1, ts_sum(power(divide(clip(subtract(AdjHigh, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), , 1), ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 2), 20))
  4. 4. ts_sum —— 过去 N 天滚动求和
    ts_sum(power(divide(clip(subtract(AdjHigh, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), , 1), ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 2), 20)
  5. 5. power —— 取幂(乘方)
    power(divide(clip(subtract(AdjHigh, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), , 1), ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), 2)
  6. 6. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(clip(subtract(AdjHigh, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), , 1), ts_delay(AdjClose, 1))
  7. 7. clip —— 裁剪到区间[下限,上限]
    clip(subtract(AdjHigh, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)), , 1)
  8. 8. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjHigh, ts_delay(AdjClose, 1))
  9. 9. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)
  10. 10. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)
  11. 11. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(1, divide(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjClose, 60)))
  12. 12. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjClose, 60))
  13. 13. ts_max —— 过去 N 天滚动最大值
    ts_max(AdjClose, 60)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 previous_close：close.shift(1)
  2. 计算 downside_tail：(previous_close - low).clip(lower=0.0) / previous_close
  3. 计算 upside_tail：(high - previous_close).clip(lower=0.0) / previous_close
  4. 计算 downside_energy：downside_tail.pow(2).滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).sum()
  5. 计算 upside_energy：upside_tail.pow(2).滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).sum()
  6. 计算 tail_asymmetry：downside_energy / (downside_energy + upside_energy)
  7. 计算 drawdown：1.0 - close / close.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=60).max()
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_tail_fragility_drawdown_asymmetry(df): """Drawdown-conditioned asymmetry of downside versus upside intraday tail excursions.""" df_copy = df.copy() previous_close = df_copy["close"].shift(1) downside_tail = (previous_close - df_copy["low"]).clip(lower=0.0) / previous_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) upside_tail = (df_copy["high"] - previous_close).clip(lower=0.0) / previous_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) downside_energy = downside_tail.pow(2).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum() upside_energy = upside_tail.pow(2).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum() tail_asymmetry = downside_energy / (downside_energy + upside_energy).replace(0.0, np.nan) drawdown = 1.0 - df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].rolling(60, min_periods=60).max().replace(0.0, np.nan) df_copy["factor_tail_fragility_drawdown_asymmetry"] = -tail_asymmetry * drawdown "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_tail_fragility_drawdown_asymmetry"]
